notes.title: Update log alpha10.4.4
notes.content:
Character performance adjustments
To improve the game's visual presentation, there have been major adjustments to the character performance in the main storyline.

Added shadows to (almost) all objects
Now (almost) all objects have shadows, making the game's visuals more realistic.

Added grid frames
To facilitate players' exploration of the game map, grid frames have been added.

Fixed issues

 Fixed an issue where Ningmu couldn't be displayed.
 Fixed a red error message that appeared when Jueming spoke.
 Fixed an issue where the fifth skill tree couldn't be opened.
 Fixed an issue where the subsequent nodes sometimes failed to update when unlocking a skill.
 Deleted unused comments in the game, reducing the log file size.

notes.title: Update Log - alpha9.4.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the entrance to the Guangyuan branch plot could not be accessed.
Added a huge and obvious version number to the start game interface.


Thank you to all players for your feedback and support. We will continue to work hard to improve the quality and user experience of the game.

notes.title: Update Alpha9.4.2
notes.content:
Fixed the black screen issue caused by the incorrect configuration of the entrance to the Jue Ming subplot and other plot entrances or transitions.
     Fixed the issue where red text appears in LeFeng's speech in the Deepwood Village plot in Chapter 1 and in YaLuo's speech in the Yuan Heng Zhai plot.
     Fixed the issue where when some facial expressions of DanTie were showing there will always appear with red text.
     Fixed some skill description errors.
     Fixed that it is allowed to switch characters during attribute allocation.
     Added a more comprehensive order judgment for units that have same waittime or move at the same time.
     Modified the healing parameter to 1+P+C.

notes.title: Update Log: Elysium Above - Hotfix 8.4.1
5.3.4 Update
notes.content: The skill tree unlocking mechanism has been enabled, though there are currently few restrictions imposed on unlocking skills. Rules and restrictions on unlocking will be added later, depending on the completeness of the plot script.
